diff --git a/openlibrary/tests/core/test_imports.py b/openlibrary/tests/core/test_imports.py
index dc9724e..0c2b8da 100644
--- a/openlibrary/tests/core/test_imports.py
+++ b/openlibrary/tests/core/test_imports.py
@@ -96,6 +96,44 @@ def import_item_db_staged(setup_item_db):
 
 
 class TestImportItem:
+    def test_find_staged_or_pending_uses_default_sources_and_filters_status(self, import_item_db):
+        import_item_db.multiple_insert(
+            'import_item',
+            [
+                {'id': 4, 'batch_id': 1, 'ia_id': 'amazon:9780000000001', 'status': 'staged'},
+                {'id': 5, 'batch_id': 1, 'ia_id': 'idb:9780000000002', 'status': 'pending'},
+                {'id': 6, 'batch_id': 1, 'ia_id': 'amazon:9780000000002', 'status': 'created'},
+                {'id': 7, 'batch_id': 1, 'ia_id': 'other:9780000000001', 'status': 'staged'},
+                {'id': 8, 'batch_id': 1, 'ia_id': 'idb:9780000000003', 'status': 'pending'},
+            ],
+        )
+
+        result = ImportItem.find_staged_or_pending(['9780000000001', '9780000000002'])
+
+        assert isinstance(result, web.db.SqliteResultSet)
+        assert {(row.ia_id, row.status) for row in result} == {
+            ('amazon:9780000000001', 'staged'),
+            ('idb:9780000000002', 'pending'),
+        }
+
+    def test_find_staged_or_pending_accepts_custom_sources(self, import_item_db):
+        import_item_db.insert(
+            'import_item',
+            id=4,
+            batch_id=1,
+            ia_id='partner:9780000000001',
+            status='staged',
+        )
+
+        result = ImportItem.find_staged_or_pending(
+            ['9780000000001'], sources=('partner',)
+        )
+
+        assert isinstance(result, web.db.SqliteResultSet)
+        assert [(row.ia_id, row.status) for row in result] == [
+            ('partner:9780000000001', 'staged')
+        ]
+
     def test_delete(self, import_item_db):
         assert len(list(import_item_db.select('import_item'))) == 3
